title: Localizing Before Answering: A Benchmark for Grounded Medical Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Textual Perturbation Test (TPT): Swapping key textual entities (such as anatomy or disease terms) in the prompt to evaluate whether the model relies on learned linguistic co-occurrences (shortcuts) rather than the actual visual evidence.

Visual Perturbation Test (VPT): Replacing the queried anatomical region in the image with the same region from an image of a different diagnostic class to test if the model relies on spurious visual shortcuts and irrelevant image areas instead of grounding its answer on the specific region of interest.
